name: EmitterFrameSel
meaning: frameSel argument of ParticleEmitter::Sfx_SpawnBillboard 0x52c763: a sprite frame index, or one of these selectors

name: EMITTER_FRAME_CYCLE
meaning: (-2) each particle takes the ring slot index modulo the frame count; Emitter_UpdateTrail (footprints) passes it

name: EMITTER_FRAME_RANDOM
meaning: (-1) each particle takes Rand_Bounded(frameCount); the other Emitter_Update* functions pass it
